name: Calendly → LearnFloo: invite bookers to the live

parameters.content:
Calendly sends invitee.created to this webhook (create the subscription with the Calendly API, see README).
Set LIVE_LINK (the live’s guest link named "Calendly") and your e-mail API in "Map to Send the invitation".
The Node.js version finds the next live and its link by itself through the LearnFloo API.
